Temporary communication outage – Outlet was offline (comm outage: 5001 ms).

Dear Robert Renz,
Thank you for your attention to the recent issue. To help prevent similar problems from occurring in the future, we recommend the following preventive measures:
Ensure the charger firmware is always updated to the latest version provided by the manufacturer.
Follow a regular maintenance schedule, including physical inspections and system checks.
By staying proactive with these steps, we can help ensure the continued reliability and performance of the charging system.
Please let us know if you need any support or guidance with implementing these measures.
